question.question: Does the official GPTrans multi-hop shortest-path bond encoding lower the development MAE of the retained BondLocal + pair-update-norm GPT-T at fixed 100K, over two matched initializations?
question.deficiency: Our GPT-T adds bond embeddings only to directly bonded pairs; pairs at hop distance >= 2 see only a distance embedding, while official GPTrans also injects the ordered path bonds (multi_hop_max_dist=20).
alternatives: BondLocal and 12 pair-propagation layers already recover path content
Distance embedding is sufficient for PCQM4Mv2
Any gain is below initialization noise
question.positive_decision: Mean of the two paired candidate-minus-reference development MAE deltas <= -3.7 meV and both negative (3.0/0.82, optimistic 18% scale attenuation) releases the frozen 500K E2; no adoption.
question.negative_decision: Otherwise close NEGATIVE_UNDER_CONTRACT: no 500K, retry, tuning grid or adoption.

profile.hardware: Tesla T4x2 FP32/noTF32, one arm per device
profile.cheapest_falsifier: Two same-job 100K 60-pass pairs (inits 43 and 44), reference BondLocal+PairNorm versus the same plus zero-start multi-hop path edge encoding; the mean paired delta must reach -3.7 meV.
